Gates

built is not the same as measured — these rows decide whether a number here is a finding or an assertion

stategatedetailwhat an open gate blocks
passSources run against the network4 companies acquired live this run — no cached responses on the acquisition path.—
passEvidence trail complete654 claims, each carrying a source and a verbatim quote.—
passOne deep-tier call per run4 deep calls across 4 runs; the client raises before a second.—
openBaseline scoredRequires actuals, which arrive when the companies report on 18–20 August — after this entry closes.Blocks any claim of measured skill.
openLambda fitted rather than assertedThe regression needs the Street's bar as it stood at past quarters. No source available publishes consensus history.Blocks the central positioning claim — which is why positioning is switched off rather than run on a guessed number.
openPer-regime beta tableSame missing input as above.Blocks the thesis as a statistical model.

Invariants

built means a test enforces it · measured means this run demonstrated it

Point in timebuiltTwo independent locks — the adapter filters on the filing date and the chain re-checks everything returned. A test trips it with a document filed one day late.
Typed provenancebuiltA claim cannot be constructed without a source and a verbatim quote; the constructor raises.
Fail closedbuiltEnforced by V1; no lens failed on this run.
Lenses blind to each otherbuiltThere is no parameter through which one lens's view could reach another. Structural, not a promise in a prompt.
Materiality, never vote countbuiltThe judge weighs on measured swing per sigma and on what survived being argued against.
Every case argued againstmeasuredThe champion stage develops each surviving view then attacks it; the surviving confidence, not the stated one, reaches the judge.
Baseline on every chartbuiltDrawn beside every forecast, and never an input to it.
Robust statisticsbuiltMedians and scaled MAD throughout; winsorize before any mean; shrink anything under eight observations.
No API between pipeline and sitebuiltPython writes JSON; this page reads it. No metric is computed here.
